![text](100,135,528,185) *In general, very expensive...*

![text](88,200,417,235) Use JOIN instead

![list](47,253,358,296)
- (THETA) JOIN

![list](125,307,460,350)
- Join of two relations

![formula](262,361,627,414) $R \bowtie_c S = \delta_c (R \times S)$

![text](344,416,875,451) $\rightarrow c$ is called a Join condition

![text](317,461,557,527) — usually using full constraint.

![text](682,451,925,540) $\rightarrow$ can only have attribute name

![text](648,538,892,640) *this is different from SELECTION condition*

![formula](227,629,682,690) $Climbs \bowtie (Cid.1 = Cid.2) Climbers$

![text](56,688,838,787) — there should be fewer tuples in JOIN compared to PRODUCT
